description: This file defines the NestedSetInterface which specifies the contract for classes representing nested set data structures within the OrangeHRM system. It includes method signatures for getting and setting left, right, and level values, as well as for managing the associated node.

methods.name: getLft
methods.description: Retrieves the left value of the nested set node.

methods.name: setLft
methods.description: Sets the left value of the nested set node.

methods.name: getRgt
methods.description: Retrieves the right value of the nested set node.

methods.name: setRgt
methods.description: Sets the right value of the nested set node.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the level/depth of the node in the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the level/depth of the node.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Returns the associated node object implementing NodeInterface.

methods.name: setNode
methods.description: Associates a NodeInterface object with this nested set node.
